layer2.pins: The cap is a CEILING, not a floor. Every criterion resolved refuted, so the weighted mean lands near 10 — far below the 30 floor — and capBinding must be false, because min() takes the weighted mean rather than lifting it. Easy to break by implementing the cap as a clamp instead of a minimum, which would silently promote every hopeless idea to exactly 30 and destroy the bottom half of the scale. Note this entry resolves its criteria WITHOUT primary conversations, which is deliberate: refutation here came from desk research the founder accepted, and Evidence Quality is still 0.
